installation.step1Desc: Inspect the installation site for structural integrity, measure roof dimensions, and perform a shading analysis using a solar pathfinder or drone survey throughout the day.
installation.step2Desc: Verify the roof or ground mount can support the array weight. Check rafter spacing, age, and material. For ground mounts, assess soil and drainage.
installation.step2Warning: A structural engineer must sign off if the roof is older than 15 years or the system exceeds 10 kWp.
installation.step3Desc: Install aluminium racking rails, L-feet brackets, and clamps. Seal all roof penetrations with EPDM flashing. Set tilt angle per engineering report.
installation.step3Warning: All roof penetrations must be sealed with appropriate flashing to prevent water ingress. Work at height requires harness.
installation.step4Desc: Mount panels onto rails. Connect in series per string using MC4 connectors. Verify Voc and polarity at each string before proceeding.
installation.step4Warning: Panels produce voltage under light — cover panels during wiring or work in low-light conditions. MC4 connectors must click firmly.
installation.step5Desc: Route DC+ and DC− cables from the string combiner box to the inverter in UV-resistant conduit. Label all cables. Crimp and terminate with correct lugs.
installation.step5Warning: DC arcs are extremely dangerous and cannot be self-extinguished like AC. Double-check all crimps.
installation.step6Desc: Mount the inverter in a well-ventilated, shaded location. Connect DC string inputs. Verify open-circuit voltage matches design before switching on.
installation.step6Warning: Ensure DC isolator is OFF before connecting any cables. Never connect DC under load.
installation.step7Desc: Install the battery in a cool, dry, ventilated space. Ensure mounting surface is level and rated for the weight. Maintain manufacturer clearances on all sides.
installation.step7Warning: Lithium batteries must not be installed in enclosed, unventilated spaces. Ensure fire suppression is accessible.
installation.step8Desc: Connect the BMS communication cable (RS485/CAN) between battery and inverter. This enables cell balancing, SoC monitoring, and charge control.
installation.step9Desc: Connect battery DC cables to the inverter battery port via a DC fuse/breaker. Verify polarity and voltage before closing the breaker.
installation.step9Warning: Battery short circuits deliver thousands of amps instantly. Always install a DC breaker and fuse between battery and inverter.
installation.step10Desc: Connect the inverter AC output to the main distribution board via a dedicated solar circuit breaker. Size the breaker for maximum inverter output current.
installation.step10Warning: All AC work must be performed by a licensed electrician. Disconnect mains before making connections.
installation.step11Desc: Install bidirectional export meter. Submit interconnection application to the DNO. Wait for utility approval before energizing.
installation.step11Warning: Do not energize until the utility has approved the grid connection. Anti-islanding protection must be verified.
installation.step12Desc: Power on the system. Verify string voltages, inverter output power, battery charge rate, and grid export. Set up Wi-Fi monitoring app and configure alerts.

assembly.surveyDesc: Measure roof dimensions, pitch, and orientation. Perform shading analysis at 9am, 12pm, and 3pm. Record GPS coordinates for irradiance lookup.
assembly.surveyTip: Take photos of the roof from each cardinal direction — invaluable for remote design review.
assembly.railsDesc: Install aluminium racking rails at calculated tilt angle. Secure L-feet brackets to rafters with lag bolts. Seal every penetration with EPDM flashing.
assembly.railsWarning: Work at height — fall protection harness and hard hat required at all times.
assembly.railsTip: Pre-drill pilot holes to prevent rafter splitting. Use a chalk line for perfect rail alignment.
assembly.railsTorque: Lag bolts: 40 Nm · Rail splice: 20 Nm
assembly.panelsDesc: Mount panels onto rails. Secure with mid-clamps (between panels) and end-clamps (at string ends). Attach grounding lugs.
assembly.panelsWarning: Panels are heavy (20 kg) and act as sails in wind. Always work in pairs. Never stand on panels.
assembly.panelsTip: Stagger panel placement to maintain roof access for future maintenance.
assembly.panelsTorque: Mid-clamp: 12 Nm · End-clamp: 14 Nm · Ground lug: 6 Nm
assembly.groundDesc: Bond all panel frames, rails, and inverter chassis to the main earth bus bar using 6mm² green/yellow copper. Drive earth rod to 1.8m minimum depth.
assembly.groundTip: Test earth resistance with a ground tester — must be ≤ 10Ω. If soil is dry/rocky, use multiple rods.
assembly.mc4Desc: Strip 8mm of insulation from each cable end. Insert into MC4 contact pin and crimp with calibrated tool. Snap housing closed until it clicks.
assembly.mc4Warning: Use only manufacturer-matched MC4 pairs. Mismatched connectors cause arcing and fire risk.
assembly.mc4Tip: Always perform a 50N pull test on every crimped connector. A failed crimp is a future fire.
assembly.stringsDesc: Connect panels in series within each string. Verify Voc builds correctly (≈49.5V per panel). Label each string at both ends.
assembly.stringsWarning: Panels produce voltage when exposed to light. Cover panels or work at dawn/dusk. Never disconnect MC4 under load.
assembly.stringsTip: Measure Isc of each string — strings should be within 5% of each other. Mismatch indicates a wiring error.
assembly.combinerDesc: Route each string pair (+ and −) into the combiner box through cable glands. Connect through string fuses (15A). Install surge protection device (SPD).
assembly.combinerWarning: Tighten cable glands to IP65 rating. Loose glands allow water ingress and corrosion.
assembly.combinerTip: Label each fuse with its string number. Document fuse ratings in the commissioning log.
assembly.dcRunDesc: Route DC cables in UV-resistant conduit from combiner box to inverter location. Use 6mm² solar-rated cable. Secure with clips every 300mm.
assembly.dcRunWarning: DC arcs cannot be extinguished like AC — they are self-sustaining. Ensure all joints are mechanically secure.
assembly.dcRunTip: Leave 500mm service loop at each end for future re-termination.
assembly.dcIsoDesc: Wire the DC isolator switch between combiner output and inverter DC input. Verify isolator is rated for system Voc and Isc.
assembly.dcIsoWarning: Verify DC isolator is in OFF position before connecting any cables. Test isolation with multimeter.
assembly.dcIsoTip: Install the isolator within arm's reach of the inverter for emergency shutdown access.
assembly.batWireDesc: Connect DC cables via fuse and breaker to inverter battery port. Connect BMS communication cable (RS485/CAN). Verify polarity.
assembly.batWireWarning: Battery short circuits deliver thousands of amps instantly. Always install a DC breaker AND fuse. Never work on a live battery.
assembly.batWireTip: Set initial charge parameters per manufacturer datasheet — wrong settings void warranty and risk thermal runaway.
assembly.acConnDesc: Connect inverter AC output (L, N, PE) through an AC isolator to a dedicated solar circuit breaker in the main distribution board.
assembly.acConnWarning: All AC work must be performed by a licensed electrician. Disconnect mains supply before making any connections.
assembly.acConnTip: Use a correctly rated Type B RCD for PV systems — Type A will not detect DC fault currents from the inverter.
assembly.gridMeterDesc: Install bidirectional export meter. Submit interconnection application to distribution network operator (DNO). Wait for formal approval before energizing.
assembly.gridMeterWarning: Do NOT energize the system until the utility has issued written grid connection approval. Anti-islanding must be tested.
assembly.gridMeterTip: Take meter readings before and after commissioning — the delta proves the system is generating and exporting.
assembly.powerOnDesc: Follow strict sequence: 1) AC main ON, 2) AC isolator ON, 3) DC isolator ON, 4) Verify Voc, 5) Inverter power ON. Record all readings.
assembly.powerOnWarning: Never turn on DC before AC on a grid-tied inverter — it needs grid reference frequency to synchronize.
assembly.powerOnTip: Take a video of the first power-on showing the inverter display — excellent proof of commissioning for warranty.
assembly.monitorDesc: Connect the inverter to Wi-Fi. Set up the manufacturer monitoring app. Configure generation alerts, fault notifications, and export limits.
assembly.monitorTip: Set a daily generation threshold alert — if the system produces less than 80% of expected, it flags a potential issue early.
assembly.transformerDesc: For systems >200 kWp, install a step-up transformer (LV 400V → MV 11kV). EPC contractor and utility coordination required.
assembly.transformerWarning: High-voltage work — only qualified HV engineers may commission the transformer. Exclusion zone required.
assembly.transformerTip: Request factory test certificates for the transformer before accepting delivery.
